title: Ridgeline Consumer Credit Standing and the Ridgeline Tool Rental Damage Deductible
content:
A Ridgeline Consumer Credit account in good standing lowers the Ridgeline Tool Rental damage deductible.

**Clause.** Ridgeline Consumer Credit standing lowers the deductible: when the renter's Ridgeline Consumer Credit account is active and shows no late fee assessed in the last 12 months, the deductible is multiplied by 0.60; when the account is active and shows one or more late fees assessed in the last 12 months, by 0.85; when the renter holds no active Ridgeline Consumer Credit account, it is unchanged.

**Last 12 months.** A late fee falls in the last 12 months when it is dated fewer than 12 whole calendar months before the day the deductible is billed.

The multiplier acts on the damage deductible before the deductible is held to the repair cost assessed at the return inspection, and the rounding to the cent is made only on the final figure.

## Records read

- The status on the renter's Ridgeline Consumer Credit account record.
- The late fee lines assessed on that account and their dates. Other fees, such as a returned payment fee, are not late fees.

## Standing table

| Ridgeline Consumer Credit account | Late fees in the last 12 months | Multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| active | none | 0.60 |
| active | one or more | 0.85 |
| suspended, closed, charged off, applied or declined | any | 1 (unchanged) |
| no account | not applicable | 1 (unchanged) |

## Hypothetical figures (deductible of 500.00 before the multiplier, deductible billed on 12 May 2026)

| Late fees on the active account | In the window | Figure |
|---|---|---|
| none | none | 300.00 |
| one dated 13 May 2025 | yes (11 whole months) | 425.00 |
| one dated 12 May 2025 | no (12 whole months) | 300.00 |
